## 🐛 Found a Bug?

If you've found a bug, please:

1. **Search existing issues** to avoid duplicates
2. **Create a bug report** using our [Bug Report Template](https://github.com/Expressive-Tea/expresive-tea/issues/new?template=bug_report.md)
3. Include a **minimal reproduction** and environment details

👉 **[Report a Bug](https://github.com/Expressive-Tea/expresive-tea/issues/new?template=bug_report.md)**

---

## ✨ Feature Request?

Have an idea to make Expressive Tea better?

1. **Check existing feature requests** to see if it's already proposed
2. **Discuss in GitHub Discussions first** (Ideas category) to refine the idea
3. **Create a feature request** using our [Feature Request Template](https://github.com/Expressive-Tea/expresive-tea/issues/new?template=feature_request.md)

👉 **[Request a Feature](https://github.com/Expressive-Tea/expresive-tea/issues/new?template=feature_request.md)**

---

## 🔒 Security Vulnerability?

**DO NOT** create a public issue for security vulnerabilities.

**Report privately:**
- **GitHub Security Advisories:** [Create Private Report](https://github.com/Expressive-Tea/expresive-tea/security/advisories/new)
- **Email:** [security@expressive-tea.io](mailto:security@expressive-tea.io)

See our [Security Policy](https://github.com/Expressive-Tea/expresive-tea/blob/develop/SECURITY.md) for details.

## 🚀 Quick Tips for Getting Help

### When Asking Questions:

✅ **DO:**
- Search existing issues and discussions first
- Provide a minimal, reproducible example
- Include error messages and stack traces
- Specify your environment (Node.js version, OS, package version)
- Use code blocks for code and error messages
- Be respectful and patient

❌ **DON'T:**
- Post large code dumps without context
- Ask multiple unrelated questions in one post
- Expect immediate responses (we're volunteers!)
- Cross-post the same question everywhere
- Share sensitive information (API keys, passwords, etc.)

### Minimal Reproducible Example:

```typescript
// ✅ Good: Minimal, focused code that reproduces the issue
import { ExpressiveTeaApplication } from '@expressive-tea/core';

const app = new ExpressiveTeaApplication();
// ... minimal code to reproduce the issue

app.start();
```

## 📦 Version Information

**Current Version:** v2.0.0 (stable)

**Package Name:**
- ✅ **New:** `@expressive-tea/core` (v2.0.0+)
- ⚠️ **Deprecated:** `@zerooneit/expressive-tea` (v1.x - maintained until April 30, 2026)

**Check your version:**
```bash
npm list @expressive-tea/core
# or
yarn list @expressive-tea/core
```

**Upgrade to latest:**
```bash
npm install @expressive-tea/core@latest
# or
yarn add @expressive-tea/core@latest
```

See the [Migration Guide](https://github.com/Expressive-Tea/expresive-tea/blob/develop/MIGRATION_GUIDE_v2.md) for upgrading from v1.x.
